h1: Je t'aime Cafe & Villa — Sleep Inside a Little European Cafe, With a Pool in Sing Buri Town
intro: If you are after a stay in Sing Buri town that feels different from an ordinary hotel — a little villa set inside a cafe, with a swimming pool for couples or anyone who loves a pretty photo corner — Je t'aime Cafe & Villa is the name locals bring up as the European-style cafe that also has rooms. It is a small boutique villa of about 6 rooms in the Pho Kruam area, with prettily decorated rooms (several named after the letters L O V E), an outdoor pool, a poolside bar, a garden, an on-site cafe and restaurant, breakfast included and free parking. What guests consistently praise is the lovely cafe ambience, the cute rooms, and having a pool in such a small place. The trade-offs to know first: there are very few rooms so it books out fast, it is a small villa rather than a full-service hotel, and some guests note that a few meals did not match the photos. Rooms start from about ฿1,079/night. Real guest reviews give it around 7.5–8.1 from over 100 reviewers.

body.html: Je t'aime Cafe & Villa, known locally as Choe-Taem cafe & villa, is a small boutique cafe-villa at 249/14 Pho Kruam Sub-district, Mueang Sing Buri District. It began as a European-style cafe and restaurant, then grew into a small accommodation within the same grounds. What keeps it on couples' and photographers' radar is its pretty European cafe ambience, an outdoor pool and poolside bar inside a tiny stay, and rooms charmingly named after the letters L O V E — ideal for travellers who want a stay with character rather than a standard hotel room.

The property has about 6 rooms across a few types — King Superior, Superior Twin and King Deluxe. Rooms come with air conditioning, a TV, a fridge and an en-suite bathroom. Several are prettily themed with little sitting corners and careful decorative touches, which many guests say they love because it feels like sleeping inside a cafe. Most rates include breakfast, served at the Je'taime coffee & restaurant about 600 metres away. Reviews agree that the atmosphere and the decor are the genuine draw, well suited to couples and photo-lovers.

"Such a cute stay — decorated in a European style that feels like being inside a cafe, with a small pool and a lovely vibe, and friendly staff. Perfect for a relaxed getaway with someone special or for taking pretty photos in Sing Buri town."

The shared areas include an outdoor pool, a poolside bar, a children's pool, a garden, and the on-site cafe and restaurant. But the things to know before booking, which reviews mention plainly, are that this is a small villa with only about 6 rooms that fills up fast on weekends, and it is a small property rather than a full-service hotel, so it does not offer the range of services a big hotel would. Another point raised in reviews is the food: a few meals that look good in photos did not live up to it in person — for instance a salmon steak that was thin and overcooked — leaving some guests underwhelmed by the meal even while praising the setting and the service. So your impression depends on expectations: come for the ambience and the stay and you will likely be charmed; come chiefly for a fine dinner and you may be let down.

The location is convenient for staying close to town. It is about 1.1 km from central Sing Buri — roughly a 15-minute walk — and about 1.5 km from the Sing Buri City Pillar Shrine. Wat Phra Non Chak Si Worawihan is about 4.3 km away, with the Bang Rachan Heroes Monument and the Bang Rachan Camp Park a short drive further, so it works well as an in-town base for exploring Sing Buri. Check-in is 14:00–21:00 and check-out is until noon. Across platforms it scores around 7.5–8.1 from over 100 reviewers, with the most-praised points being the atmosphere, the decor and the friendliness of the staff.

Honestly, Je t'aime Cafe & Villa is a cafe-style stay for people who want a pretty setting and a pool in a small place — not a big-room hotel or a full-service resort. If you want a hotel with more rooms and full service by the river, Chaisaeng Palace Hotel may suit you better, or for newer, neater rooms in town, Central Park Hotel is an option. But if your goal is European cafe ambience, a pool, cute rooms for a couple, and a location near town, this place delivers nicely at a modest price — just book ahead because rooms are few, and don't set your hopes too high on a gourmet meal.

Tips from people who follow reviews here: book early because there are only about 6 rooms and they fill fast on holidays, and note the themed room you want when you reserve. Come mainly for the ambience and the stay; for the main meal, try the cafe menu or head out to eat in town nearby. Make the most of the pool and poolside bar in the evening, and catch the cafe corners in good light. The stay is close to town — a short walk or drive to restaurants and markets, and an easy morning out for noodles or rice dishes. Compare Agoda with Trip.com each time, as rates move with holidays, and check whether the room you book includes breakfast.
